reason: The 13-arm fusion study has ordinary soft/hard/source-residual heads but must also compare direct raw-teacher overwrite on exactly the same larger multiview evidence.
fixed_method: RAW_TEACHER_FILL: per query/TrackID mean over observed per-view mean probabilities at legacy actually asked cells, otherwise the existing RAW_FINAL ordinary head; same independent >.5 decoder.
code_may_not_use: GT, official scores, future answers, unrequested cache values, a newly fitted head, or any extra teacher call.
scope: Six cross-domain experimental settings x seeds0/17/42, CPU-only supplemental sealed predictions using immutable core fusion outputs.
primary_remains: DS_FULL from core preregistration; supplement is an additional ordinary baseline, never a post-hoc promoted method.
count_controls: Compare full and direct-fill ranking at both per-query/per-frame predicted counts, with exact self-count checks.
GT_barrier: All supplemental raw and count outputs sealed before supplemental official evaluation; core468 remains a separate already registered seal/GT group. No claim all combined outputs preceded core GT.
count_variants: FULL-at-FULL, FILL-at-FULL, FULL-at-FILL, FILL-at-FILL; both self-counts exact.
analysis: Core primary vs direct fill, both quantity controls, three neural seeds, same parent grouping; KITTI4 point/sensitivity only.
